description: Quadcopter developer kit from the PX4 ecosystem: an X-frame with four motors, a Pixhawk flight-controller stack and a documented power-distribution board. Geometry and link masses come from the PX4 Gazebo model (x500_base in PX4/PX4-gazebo-models, BSD-3-Clause); the kit hardware (2216 920KV motors, 20A ESCs, 4S battery) comes from Holybro's X500 V2 product page.
name: px4-x500

wiring.note: The X500 kit's documented power path (Holybro): the battery plugs into the power-distribution board (XT60), the board feeds the four ESCs (XT30) and, through the PM02 power module, the Pixhawk. ESC output to the motors is PWM — duty-limited, not a fixed rail — so those connections carry no voltage and are never voltage-checked. Voltages are the kit's documented 4S values; anything unsourced is 'not specified'.
